question: Can an unchanged legal regime react to an officially confirmed categorical real-world fact by generating a new time-bounded legal geography?

governing_rules.effect: On official confirmation, immediately declare the affected location infected and establish an appropriate restricted zone.
Establish the restricted zone around the affected location, taking the listed epidemiological and geographical criteria into account.
For HPAI, establish at least a 3 km protection zone and a 10 km surveillance zone around the outbreak, subject to the Regulation's qualifications.

official_case_confirmation.national_statement: HPAI confirmed in Woerdense Verlaat; a 3 km protection zone and 10 km surveillance zone were imposed immediately, including a transport ban in the 10 km zone.

temporal_separation.statement: The finding date, the immediate national control start, and the later published end dates are separate temporal facts; zone geometry does not own duration.

authoritative_metric_observation_v0_1.reason: HPAI confirmation is a categorical official finding, not a scalar numeric observation.

authoritative_dynamic_set_v0_1.reason: The outbreak is not an existing member changing membership/status in an authoritative set. A restricted area may later be listed, but that is downstream of the finding.

temporal_v0_1.reason: Temporal assertions can own start/end dates but not disease truth, outbreak location or zone geometry.

metric_rule_evaluation_v0_1.reason: Coordinates and radii are not scalar legal metrics whose meaning is captured by the bounded numeric predicate/formula contract.

change_atom_v0_3.reason: The governing rules are unchanged; the causal input is an official real-world finding.

forbidden_inferences: The HPAI finding is a textual mutation of Regulation (EU) 2016/429 or Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/687.
The outbreak itself is a scalar metric merely because its location has numeric coordinates.
The outbreak becomes legally real only when the later Commission implementing decision republishes the zones.
The 3 km and 10 km zones are direct scientific findings rather than legal spatial consequences generated from the finding and binding rules.
The zone geometry owns its own duration.
A later EU list entry should overwrite the earlier national official confirmation event.

official_sources.locator: official confirmation and immediate 3 km/10 km control measures
